purpose: Teach: 位相/流体/研磨/僻地/共振/界面/発振/電極

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行時刻の位相分析を、警察、おこなわれますね
lines.en: For this case, the police conduct phase analysis of the time of the crime, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful tone. Ren is asking a clarifying question, not challenging. Slight pause before the final phrase, weighing the procedural detail.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、流体の漏出事故も担当します
lines.en: The police handle fluid leak accidents as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional confirmation. Officer Takeda states this evenly, without elaboration. Direct eye contact. No performance in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、研磨剤の不正使用を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: For this case, the police would handle the misuse of abrasives, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain. Ren is probing to understand the scope of the investigation. Genuine question, not rhetorical.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、僻地での失踪事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to missing persons cases in remote areas.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Takeda adds another detail to his list without changing pace or emphasis. Professional and complete.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、共振現象が原因の建物倒壊を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: For this case, the police would handle building collapses caused by resonance phenomena, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Deliberate pacing on the technical phrase. Ren is testing his understanding of what falls under police jurisdiction. Respectful curiosity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、界面活性剤を悪用した犯行も把握します
lines.en: The police also understand cases involving the misuse of surfactants in criminal activity.
lines.style: Calm, comprehensive. Takeda confirms another capability. His tone remains level, assured without being condescending.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、無線発振機の不正使用を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: For this case, the police would handle the unauthorized use of radio oscillators, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Ren continues his line of inquiry with the same respectful tone. He's building understanding through confirmation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、電極にDNAが付着した事案も鑑定します
lines.en: The police also conduct forensic analysis on cases where DNA is found on electrodes.
lines.style: Precise, confident. Takeda delivers this with subtle emphasis on the forensic capability. His tone has warmed slightly—he recognizes Ren's genuine engagement.
